PRACTISING LICENCE

Practising as a Certified Chartered Tax Advisor

The designation "Certified Chartered Tax Advisor" is conferred annually on Standard members who meet the Council's professional practising standards. Practising members follow the Professional Conduct in Relation to Taxation and Professional Rules and Practice Guidelines adopted by ACCTA.

Passed the prescribed examination, or been exempted from it

Complied with the Council's continuing professional development requirements

Satisfied the Council that you are a fit and proper person to practise

Hold professional indemnity insurance as prescribed by the Council

Registered with the IRD as a tax agent / authorised representative, and paid all fees

Licence fees

Application feeRs. 5,000
Annual licence feeRs. 15,000

Fees shown are provisional and await confirmation. Online applications and renewals are not available yet. Please contact ACCTA for guidance.
